subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: When e2e-plan is invoked on an approved e2e design doc, the skill shall decompose it into an ordered plan of per-scenario tasks, plus a conventions task landing the harness's scenario contract and one worked scenario — omitted only when the repo already carries a scenario built against that harness — plus a harness task only when the feature's e2e harness does not already exist, and project it onto the tracker as ordinary tasks.
rationale: the plan is the buildable output; ordinary tasks so the existing executor consumes them; the conventions task creates the shape parallel scenario workers copy instead of each inventing one; neither the conventions task nor the harness task is emitted when the repo already supplies it
fit_criterion: on the dogfood, e2e-plan produces one task per scenario plus a conventions task iff no scenario is already built against the harness plus a harness task iff no harness already exists, projected onto the tracker; the tasks validate against the existing task and charter schema; a fixture with a pre-existing harness and existing scenarios yields zero harness tasks and zero conventions tasks
